The structure of Zr4Zn12Ga4 (ZrZn3Ga) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 20 atoms in the unit cell across 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Ga and Zr each 12 Zn neighbors, while Zn has 12 neighbors (4 Ga, 4 Zr, 4 Zn), all at 2.8131 Å, forming a close-packed-like local arrangement. The geometric neighbor graph is connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Zn polyhedra, edge-sharing between Ga and Zr polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ga polyhedra.
